mapping.summary: Emails invoices, reminders, quotes and other documents from BC using editable templates.
claims: Sends documents to customers and suppliers both manually and from automated processes
Sends invoices as PDF by email
Attaches related receipts to credit notes and reminders
Bundles extra documents with order confirmations
Takes recipient and sender from the document automatically
Sends shipment notifications with tracking link when used with Comsol Multiship
Flexible choice of recipient and sender mailbox per template
One template can hold several languages and picks the document's language
Email body editor with placeholders for any BC field
Reusable attachments managed centrally and shared across templates
Flat fee of EUR 100 per month regardless of user count
12-month minimum term billed a year in advance
Works with BC Essentials and Premium
